query:
SELECT count(*) AS "n!: i64"
               FROM posts p
               JOIN boards b ON b.id = p.board_id
               JOIN roles r ON r.name = json_extract(b.policy, '$.read')
               WHERE p.status = 'published' AND p.kind = 'post'
                 AND r.rank <= ?1 AND (?2 IS NULL OR p.board_id = ?2)
